SELECT
    p."viewcount" AS total_views,
    p."ownerdisplayname" AS user_who_posted_last
FROM
    "posts" p
WHERE
    p."title" = 'Computer Game Datasets'
    AND p."posttypeid" = 1  
ORDER BY
    p."creationdate" DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH yearly_kickoff_adv_budget AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(b."amount") AS total_amount
    FROM
        "budget" b
    JOIN
        "event" e ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
    WHERE
        b."category" = 'Advertisement'
        AND e."event_name" = 'Yearly Kickoff'
),
october_meeting_adv_budget AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(b."amount") AS total_amount
    FROM
        "budget" b
    JOIN
        "event" e ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
    WHERE
        b."category" = 'Advertisement'
        AND e."event_name" = 'October Meeting'
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN om.total_amount = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE yk.total_amount::FLOAT / om.total_amount
    END AS budget_ratio
FROM
    yearly_kickoff_adv_budget yk,
    october_meeting_adv_budget om;
